title: Graph Theory
description: Königsberg had seven bridges, and nobody could cross each exactly once. Euler showed why not, and drew the first graph. Unlocks the Graph Loom.

puzzle.goal: A map drawn on a sheet without crossings has V junctions and L links. Write how many regions F it cuts the sheet into, the outside included.
puzzle.name: Euler's relation
puzzle.ask: Find F for V = @{V} and L = @{L}.
puzzle.method: A tree has V − 1 links and one region; every link added after that closes a loop and splits a region in two.
